chapter_name: Trial Balance and Rectification of Errors
learning_objective: 🎯 Check your math and fix your mistakes! Learn how to test the mathematical accuracy of your books and correct errors without using an eraser.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: It is a statement where you list all Debit balances on one side and all Credit balances on the other. Because every debit has an equal credit, the two column totals MUST be identical. If they match, your math is likely correct.

main_concepts.concept_title: 🙈 Errors that DO NOT affect the Trial Balance
main_concepts.simple_explanation: Sometimes the totals match, but errors exist. Examples: Error of Omission (you completely forgot to record a transaction) or Error of Principle (treating a machine purchase as a routine expense).
In accounting, you cannot scratch out or use a correction pen. You must pass a 'Rectifying Journal Entry' to cancel the wrong effect and apply the correct effect.

If your Trial Balance doesn't match and you are out of time, you temporarily put the difference into a 'Suspense Account' to force it to balance. As you find errors later, you fix them through this account.

fun_activity.title: 🔧 The Reverse Engineering Fix
fun_activity.instructions: Follow the 3-step rectification rule: 1. What was the WRONG entry? 2. What SHOULD HAVE been the CORRECT entry? 3. Compare them to create the RECTIFYING entry. Try this with: 'Paid ₹500 to Ram, but wrongly debited it to Shyam'.

exam_tips: 📌 An Error of Principle (like treating capital expenditure as revenue expenditure) will NEVER cause the Trial Balance to disagree.
📌 If a one-sided error is found AFTER preparing the Trial Balance, it must be rectified using the Suspense Account.
📌 'Under-casting' means the total was too low. 'Over-casting' means the total was too high. To fix under-casting, post on the SAME side. To fix over-casting, post on the OPPOSITE side.
quick_recap: ⭐ The Trial Balance checks arithmetical accuracy but is not conclusive proof of zero errors.
⭐ Errors of omission, commission, principle, and compensating errors require rectification.
⭐ The Suspense Account is a temporary parking spot for unknown differences.
